statements.text: File No. USD01-WRKS0/30/2026-WORKS contains a proposal to accord administrative sanction for Rs.1.30 crore for the emergency restoration of a storm water drain at Ward No.21, Seetharampuram Municipal Corporation.
statements.quote: The Commissioner, Urban Services, has submitted (Flag A) that a storm water drain at Ward No.21, Seetharampuram Municipal Corporation was breached in the heavy rains of 18-09-2026, and has proposed to accord administrative sanction for Rs.1.30 crore for emergency restoration.

statements.text: Under Circular Memo No.USD01-WRKS0/9/2023, Dt.11-07-2023, the Commissioner, Urban Services, may accord administrative sanction for emergency works up to Rs.1.50 crore per work.
statements.quote: In order to avoid delays, it is clarified that the Commissioner, Urban Services, may accord administrative sanction for emergency works up to Rs.1.50 crore per work.

statements.text: Under G.O.Ms.No.27, Dated: 06-08-2024, works costing above Rs.1.00 crore, including emergency works, can only be sanctioned by the Government.
statements.quote: Works (including emergency works) costing above Rs.1.00 crore – Government only.

statements.text: Under G.O.Ms.No.27, Dated: 06-08-2024, the Commissioner may accord administrative sanction for emergency works up to Rs.1.00 crore per work, subject to ratification by the Government within thirty (30) days.
statements.quote: Emergency works: the Commissioner may accord administrative sanction up to Rs.1.00 crore per work, subject to ratification by the Government within thirty (30) days.

statements.text: G.O.Ms.No.14, Dated: 18-03-2021, which is superseded, delegated powers to the Commissioner, Urban Services, to accord administrative sanction up to Rs.50.00 lakhs per work.
statements.quote: Commissioner, Urban Services – up to Rs.50.00 lakhs per work.
